# Andreas Grape

> Stockholm-based serial entrepreneur and angel investor. Co-founder of Nordic Angels (2020, with Ash Pournouri) — the operating system for the Nordic private capital market. 25+ years building, scaling, and exiting companies. Co-owner of Angel House, a private members club for angels and creatives in Stockholm.

## Companies founded

- [Nordic Angels](https://nordicangels.com/): The investor network running the Nordic angel layer. Co-founded 2020 with Ash Pournouri.
- [Angel House](https://www.angelhouse.se/): Private members club for angels and creatives. Stockholm, opened 2025.
- [Mingla](https://mingla.io/): Gamified networking software for events where capital and talent meet.
- [Nordisia](https://nordisia.se/): Matching Nordic private capital with institutional-grade real estate development.
- [Secondry](https://www.secondry.com/): Gateway to Nordic private market secondaries.
- [Angel Advisory](https://angeladvisory.com/): Bridging angels with corporate finance (Nordic Angel Office / Nordic Corporate Finance).

## Key facts

- Backed Academic Work in 2001 — now Scandinavia's largest staffing company.
- Built and exited an IT consulting company (2008–2021).
- Building cross-border private-capital infrastructure across Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, and Helsinki.
